intro.title: Emerald Stone
intro.description: The vivid Green Emerald Gemstone is one of the most precious and highly regarded of all the gemstones. The Emerald gemstones have enjoyed widespread popularity since ancient times. They have symbolized royalty and have been revered throughout history. For the ruling class, such as kings, emperors and nobles, it was a prized possession in both ancient Egypt and India. Most of the Gemologists know that a perfect Emerald gemstone is very rarely found. Its healing properties are recognized across the globe.

tabs.tab1_description:
Emerald gemstone is a very beautiful and stunning stone and it is categorized in the top three stones of the world along with Ruby and Sapphires. It is a type of Beryl and a green gemstone. It possesses a hexagonal crystal structure and vitreous sheen. The green color of emerald is due to traces of chromium and vanadium. Emerald is considered a precious gem and it is 7.5-8 on the Mohs scale of hardness. The significance of emerald is eternity along with everlasting love.

Six thousand years ago, the world fell in love with the Emerald stone's alluring green beauty. This gemstone retains its value, with some stones exceeding diamonds in terms of carat weight. However, Emerald has much more to offer than its exquisite beauty. There is a reason why this gem has captivated kings, jewelers, and philosophers for hundreds of years. Even Aristotle was reportedly captivated by Emerald, writing that it should be worn around the neck to prevent falling sickness.

The Emerald's name derives from the Sanskrit word 'Marakata', which means the green of growing things. We cannot conceive of a more poetic moniker for this gemstone of growth, love, and regenerative power. The term Emerald is also derived from the Greek word 'Smaragdos', which means 'green gemstone'. In Hindi, it is called 'Panna'. Since ages, its jewelry has been worn and patronized by Royal families and the affluent class.

The promise of eternity and lasting love is a recurrent theme emanating from Emerald gemstone, and like all green stones and crystals, is associated with the heart chakra. Green is said to be the most craved color by our bodies and minds. Emerald possesses immense healing properties. It is both stimulating and calming, serving as a symbol of love and rebirth. There is much to admire about this green beryl, and for those who wish to embrace the notion and spiritual significance of eternity, emerald serves as a constant reminder that although all things will fade away, spiritual truth resides in a timeless heart.

Emerald is the gemstone of love, compassion, forgiveness, truthfulness, fidelity, in short, it heals the heart. Its properties also include enhancing of intuitive, clairvoyant and psychic abilities. In fact, it has been worn by Sages and wise ones for this attribute down history and continues to date. Green Emerald healing properties also include physical, mental, emotional and spiritual healing.

Historically a status symbol, there is no doubt that the emeralds are very fortunate. These lustrous and vivacious gemstones are here to fill your life with love and lasting happiness. The emerald gemstone wants you to experience the brilliance of a life well-lived, from strengthening relationships to nourishing your deepest self, fostering light and laughter, and eliminating fear and mistrust. Even though emeralds are expensive, they will remain by your side for the remainder of your days and for all of eternity.

In Vedic Astrology, the significance of Emerald Greenstone is important and valued by astrologers, when it is natural, untreated and unheated. It is recommended to buy a panna stone from a trustworthy, reputed gemstone dealer who provides a valid certificate of authentication as this is an expensive gemstone.

Green Emerald jewelry has been in the wish list of jewelry lovers all over the world. Mesmerizing Green Emerald Rings, Earrings, Necklaces, Pendants, Bracelets and other Emerald jewelry is desired for women.

As it stands for love and fidelity, Green Emerald is often worn as Engagement Rings.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Emerald gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Emerald. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Heart Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Emerald is extremely advantageous for fashion designers, decorators, painters, and musicians. This stone is of great benefit to leaders, politicians, public speakers, managers, and team leaders as it enhances their communication abilities.

The emerald stone reduces the likelihood of deception and business losses, and increases the wearer's decision-making ability and intuition. Therefore, it is extremely advantageous for businessmen.

Panna stone seals all sorts of love thus it is perfect to wear as an engagement ring. It helps to preserve harmony in relationships by nurturing feelings of compassion and kindness.

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Emerald gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Emerald gemstones.

Emerald Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Today, four countries account for the majority of emerald production: Colombia, Zambia, Brazil, Ethiopia, and Zimbabwe. These countries consistently produce wholesale quantities of emeralds. Minor or irregular production comes from Madagascar, Nigeria, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Canada, Russia, and a handful of other nations.

Over 70% of all emeralds on the market are sourced from Colombia, which generates typically bluish-green emeralds. Nevertheless, Zambia produces the finest emeralds.

Observe their Color:

Emerald is distinguished by the color green. To qualify as an emerald, a specimen must possess a green hue that ranges from bluish green to green to lightly yellowish green, and possess a brilliant and vivid green hue. In emeralds, the color must be evenly distributed throughout the stone, with no significant color zoning.

Notice their Clarity:

The most desirable emeralds have a tone that is neither too light or too dark. When the emerald gemstone is too light it can appear pale and inexpensive, whereas an emerald that is too dark lacks the distinctive vibrancy and color of an emerald.

Examine their Inclusions:

Inclusions are common in emeralds, and it is very difficult to find a flawless specimen. Liquids, gases, and trace minerals become entrapped in the stone during its formation. In fact, if the stone contains no inclusions, there is a high probability that it is not a natural emerald.

See their Shape:

Ideal shapes for enhancing the hue and brilliance of emeralds are symmetrical, open, and uniform. The emerald cut is one of the most traditional designs for an emerald. While this shape may be optimal for an emerald, the round cut is another very popular shape. This is an ideal cut for rings, particularly engagement rings, because it accentuates the emerald's radiance and luster and is incredibly refined when combined with diamonds.

Other prominent emerald shapes include oval, pear, cabochon, heart, and cushion.

Check the Carats:

For Emerald of gem quality, the raw Emerald is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Emerald weighing between 2 and 6 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Emerald is sold by weight, Emerald prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Emerald has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Emerald:

Due to treatments the Emerald stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Emerald do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Emerald gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Emeralds are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Emerald from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Emerald gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Emerald gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Emerald is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality emeralds are pure green in color with vivid color saturation and tone that is not too dark. The color should be evenly distributed with no visible color zone.

Cut

Rough emerald gemstones can break due to their fissures. The best quality emeralds have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, and saturation.

Carat

Emerald of 2 – 6 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Emeralds are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Emerald rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

In the case of emeralds, typically, they contain inclusions visible to the naked eye. Emeralds with no inclusions to the unaided eye are super-rare and valuable. Thus, the emeralds with some inclusions are readily accepted, traded and used. Emeralds with the least inclusions and best clarity are considered of premium quality.

Traders deal in emeralds which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Emerald gemstone Price

Today, emerald, ruby, and sapphire constitute the "big three" of colored gemstones. These "big three" generate more revenue than the combined value of all other colored stones in the world. Since 2015, the value of emeralds shipped into the United States surpassed the total value of the other gemstones included in the "big three".

Common treatments have a significant impact on emerald value and final price tag but are rarely discussed. The overwhelming majority of emeralds are treated with oil or resin fillers to improve their clarity. In the gemstones market as a whole, untreated emeralds of significant size and weight that have not been treated are a rarity.

However, you should prefer untreated emeralds to reap the benefits of their numerous beneficial properties. When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Emerald has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Emerald stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Emerald gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 30,720 to INR 6,52,320 (USD 384 to USD 8.154).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Emerald?

The best way to check the authenticity of Emerald is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Emeralds are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Emerald carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that an Emerald is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Emeralds have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Emeralds, but if you find flaws, then your Emerald is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Emeralds are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Emerald. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Emerald, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Emerald from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Emerald. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Emerald. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Emerald Cleaning & Maintenance

When dirt collects on the surface of emeralds, they can appear greasy and filmy. If you do not want to take it to a professional jeweler for cleaning, you can easily and effectively clean it at home with soap and water.

Choose a gentle liquid soap and mix it with warm water to create a sudsy solution. Use a soft cloth or toothbrush to gently clean your emerald jewelry by placing it in this solution. Try to reach the hard-to-reach areas, as this is where the majority of the dirt will accumulate.

After this, thoroughly rinse the emerald jewelry under running water to remove all traces of soap. Use a lint-free cloth to remove excess moisture before storing or wearing the garment.

Ultrasonic cleaners should never be used on emeralds due to the stone's susceptibility to fracture.

mainEntity.name: How long does Emerald last? Do I need to wear another Emerald after 2 years?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper care, the effects of Emerald will last for generations. The majority of the time, they balance the chakras, we learn the lessons and align with the planets, and we may no longer need them after a period of time.

mainEntity.name: How many carats of Emerald should I wear?

acceptedAnswer.text: Emerald weighing between 2 and 6 carats are appropriate for harnessing its properties.

mainEntity.name: How to clean and maintain the Emerald Stone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can wash it with soapy water and use a soft toothbrush or cloth to remove stains, dirt, etc. You can read in detail in the Quality & Price Section.

mainEntity.name: How to use and wear Emerald gemstone?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the best results, use the stone as a Ring or Pendant and it has to be worn as per Rudraksha Ratna Science Therapy, RRST, which is a scientific healing method devised by Sakhashree Neetaji. To know the right placement of Emerald gemstone, you may contact us as our team of experts will guide you.

mainEntity.name: What rules or precautions need to be followed to wear Emerald?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not need to follow any precautions if you are wearing the Emerald as per RRST.

mainEntity.name: Can I keep Emerald in my pocket to receive benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Emerald will activate and work only if it is in contact with your body at the correct position. To experience 100% results from Emerald you have to wear it as per RRST. Please consult our RRST counselors for guidance.

mainEntity.name: Does heated Emerald work?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, heated Emerald does not work.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to re-energize Emerald?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have worn the Emerald continuously you may not need to re-energize it. It is advisable to energize it if you have not worn it for an extended period of time. You can follow the steps mentioned in the Benefits Section.
